schema: members: name -> file, status nonsegmented (ccv1c -O) and segmented (sccv1c -O), note
compiler: v1c (ccv1c, sccv1c): v1 with OLD_D63 and the libcisam switches OLD_D3W, OLD_D2PW, OLD_D3Q, OLD_D3H, OLD_D2CT (compare/libcisam/COMPILER.md, host/OLDCC.md v1c). Both archives byte-identical (checkall 2026-11-19).

util.o.note: error() writes sizeof("\r\nFatal system error: ") bytes: the NUL too.

key.o.note: kycopy needs the casts (int *) in wdcopy (the reload of the parameters).

node.o.note: btremove: `tp->t_off != 0 ? ip2 : ip1` (the plain `tp->t_off ?` takes r6 for the test, segmented).

buf.o.note: bfwrite: `if (off != 0)` (with `if (off)` the segmented code takes rr2 for the trailer bytes).

supp.o.note: freefile: the three `close` take r6, r3, r6 in the original (v1 r3, r3, r6): OLD_D3H (the frame home of fp loaded in the condition goes back at its end).

read.o.note: isread: the lock test as `switch (lock) { case 0: ...; case ISLOCK: break; default: ... goto out; }` (the if/else form keeps v1's register r2 free at the else part, the original has it busy).

audit.o.note: isaudit AUDSTOP, close(filep->f_audfd): nonsegmented the original takes r3 for the value (v1 r6), segmented it loads into r7 through rr4 directly (v1 copies). OLD_D2CT (with OLD_D3H).

open.o.note: isopen: the magic read as `(char)*(unsigned char *)dictp` and `(char)((unsigned char *)dictp)[1]` (the cast makes v1 load dictp again, as the original). Nonsegmented open: isexit takes rr2 for `filep->f_fileid` behind `!(openp->o_mode & ISEXCLLOCK)` and r3 for the ?: of isstat2 (the original frees the word register at the end of the condition, segmented it keeps the pair). Forms tried: host/OLDCC_LOG.md. OLD_D3W makes it exact.

btree.o.note: btdelitem: `bad:` inside the error branch. Nonsegmented open: btsearch `openp->o_flags |= 020` behind `r == 0 && mode == 2 && bp->bf_level == 0` takes r2 (bp) as free in the original, v1 keeps it (OLD_D3); segmented the original keeps the pair. No source form found; OLD_D3W makes it exact.

item.o.note: itcompare FLOATTYPE: OLD_D63. itpress: the leading compression loop as a goto loop; `(int)it_dupnum` for stint; `i = ...;` in front of its test. Nonsegmented open: `bycmpr(..., kp->k_len)` copies kp into r4 in the original (v1 r2): OLD_D2PW. Segmented open: itunpack `it_leadcnt`/`it_trailcnt = ... ? *p++ & 0377 : 0` stores through rr2 after the arm loaded the old p into rr2 (a bug of the old scodgen: the value goes into the buffer): OLD_D3Q; itpress takes rr2 (kp from its frame home) as free behind `if (kp->k_flags & TCOMPRESS)` and `if (kp->k_flags & ISDUPS)`: OLD_D3H.

build.o.note: isaddindex in the original's order (the .extern order shows it): the recovery block inside the loop head (`done:`), `bad:` at the end; isbuild stores the magic through `(unsigned char *)dictp` (the original loads dictp again for the second byte); btrecover with two `if`s.
